mode audit
protect \MapleStory.exe
block-files on
block-registry on
block-volume-serial off
block-process-memory off
block-process-create off
block-raw-disk off
block-network off
default-deny on
deny|file|\Device\HarddiskVolume*\Outside|rights=read
deny|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\Key|value=Secret|rights=read
allow|registry|\REGISTRY\MACHINE\Key|rights=read,enumerate
